_README: BenOS Help → System Status reads this file to show notices to everyone using BenOS.
Where it must live: the ROOT of github.com/BenjaminOriginals/BenOS-Genesis, on the main branch (same folder as index.html).
BenOS fetches it each time someone opens Help (it re-checks at most once a minute). GitHub can take up to ~5 minutes to show a new version.
JSON can't have comments, so these notes live in keys that start with an underscore. BenOS ignores every key except "notices", so you can leave all of this in.
No notices right now? Keep "notices" as an empty list: [ ]. (Deleting the file also means 'no notices'.)
BenOS shows at most 3 notices. Titles are cut at 120 characters, messages at 600. Text is shown as plain text (no HTML, no links).
_HOW_TO_POST_A_NOTICE: 1. Copy one of the examples from "_EXAMPLES" below.
2. Paste it inside the [ ] of "notices" (separate several notices with commas).
3. Change the title, message and dates, then commit the file.
Check your JSON is valid before committing (e.g. paste it into jsonlint.com): one missing comma and BenOS shows no notices at all.

_FIELDS.level: How serious it is. One of: "outage" (red: something is down), "warning" (amber: a known issue), "info" (blue: a general note), "resolved" (blue: it's fixed). Anything else counts as "info".
_FIELDS.title: Short headline, shown in bold and on the Help Home banner. Example: "Weather is delayed".
_FIELDS.message: One or two plain sentences: what's affected and what people should do.
_FIELDS.updated: Optional. When you last changed the notice, in ISO format with a Z for UTC: "2026-11-06T15:30:00Z". Shown as 'Updated Nov 6, 3:30 PM' in the reader's own time zone.
_FIELDS.until: Optional. When BenOS should stop showing it automatically, same format. Leave it out to show the notice until you remove it.

_WHAT_PEOPLE_SEE: outage  → the Help Home banner and the toolbar pill turn red ('Outage'), with your title and message.
warning → amber banner and pill ('Service issue').
info    → shown on System Status, and on the Home banner only when nothing else is wrong.
resolved → shown on System Status as 'Resolved: …'. Remove it (or set "until") after a day or so.
Notices come first: a red/amber notice wins over BenOS's own live checks in the banner.
